public_text: WHO warns that the outbreak has the potential to cause severe political, social, and economic upheaval while an international mission studies severity and transmission.
source_title: WHO Director-General's opening remarks at the mission briefing on COVID-19

public_text: WHO reports new cases and deaths in Iran, adding to evidence that transmission is spreading beyond China.
source_title: WHO Director-General's opening remarks at the media briefing on COVID-19 on 20 February 2020

public_text: CDC confirms a California infection with no reported relevant travel or known exposure, describing it as a possible first instance of community spread in the United States.
source_title: CDC confirms possible instance of community spread of COVID-19 in U.S.

public_text: WHO assesses that COVID-19 can be characterized as a pandemic after cases outside China increase sharply across more countries.
source_title: WHO Director-General's opening remarks at the media briefing on COVID-19 - 11 March 2020

public_text: The Federal Reserve cuts the federal-funds target range to 0-0.25 percent and announces at least $500 billion of Treasury and $200 billion of agency mortgage-backed-security purchases.
The Federal Reserve announces open-ended purchases needed for market functioning plus new credit facilities supporting employers, consumers, and businesses.
source_title: Federal Reserve announces extensive new measures to support the economy

public_text: The CARES Act becomes Public Law 116-136 after passing the Senate, House, and receiving the President's signature.
